app.title: Aircraft Map Tracking MVP
app.subtitle: A private chart-management and map-linking desktop product, now upgraded to the MVP 2.0 multi-page scaffold.
pages.map.title: Map and Aircraft Monitoring
pages.map.subtitle: Track the aircraft and display georeferenced charts directly as overlays on the map.
pages.charts.title: Chart Management
pages.charts.subtitle: Import local PDF/image charts, maintain metadata, and prepare georeferencing.
pages.settings.title: System Settings
pages.settings.subtitle: Manage language, data source, and local storage strategy in one place.
map.title: Flight Map
map.subtitle: The MVP now uses a free Leaflet + OpenStreetMap basemap and can later switch to another compatible tile source.
status.title: Flight Status
status.subtitle: Core fields from the current user aircraft state.
status.heading: Heading
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Language and data-source strategy are managed here.
settings.providerNotice: SimConnect is the default. If MSFS is not running yet, switch to Mock mode to keep building and testing the UI.
charts.librarySubtitle: This section shows SQLite chart records and lets you open chart details.
charts.emptyDescription: Click the import button to add PDF or image charts into the local library.
charts.importSubtitle: Import the file first, maintain metadata next, then finish the map-to-chart two-point binding.
charts.stepUpload: 1. Import local PDF / PNG / JPG chart files
charts.stepMetadata: 2. Configure chart title, airport code, type, and related metadata
charts.stepReference: 3. Pick two points on the map and two matching points on the chart
charts.stepViewer: 4. Show the chart as an overlay on the map or in a dedicated viewer with aircraft position
charts.storageSubtitle: Both the database and chart files stay local, while SQLite keeps the metadata and file paths.
charts.multiPagePdfNotSupported: Only single-page PDFs are supported right now. Please split the PDF into one page before importing.
charts.pdfRasterizeFailed: Failed to convert the PDF into an operation image. Please retry or use another PDF.
charts.canvasUnavailable: The current environment could not create a Canvas rendering context.
charts.importFailed: Failed to import chart. Please try again.
chartDetail.title: Chart Detail
chartDetail.subtitle: Maintain metadata, finish two-point registration, and display aircraft position on the chart.
chartDetail.metaSubtitle: Maintain the basic chart information here.
chartDetail.referenceSubtitle: Record two map points first, then click the two matching points on the chart.
chartDetail.mapPickerSubtitle: Click twice on the mini-map to record map points, or capture the current aircraft position as a shortcut.
chartDetail.viewerSubtitle: Click on the operation image to record two matching points; whether the original file was an image or a single-page PDF, the app now uses one unified image workflow.
chartDetail.viewerNoAssetDescription: The chart record exists, but its asset did not make it back to the renderer. If this keeps happening, re-import the chart.
chartDetail.viewerEmpty: The chart content is not loaded yet.
